title: Practice 5: Instrumental endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Mary has always been a model student.
exercises.why: Nouns in the instrumental case decline unusually compared to other cases, using rules that aren't found elsewhere. While not as complex as the genitive plural, it still warrants extra attention. So masculine and neuter nouns have the endings **ом**, **ем**, or **ём**, and feminine nouns have **ой**, **ей**, **ёй**, or **ью**. Adjectives modifying masculine or neuter nouns in the instrumental case have two endings: adjectives which have the default ending **ый** or **ое** have the instrumental ending **ым**, and those which end in **ий** or **ее** have **им**. Feminine adjectives have the same endings as the genitive, prepositional, and dative cases: **ой**, or, if the adjective's stem ends… — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.
